thread:
alex: Heads-up — Orion Labs POC is ready to sign but legal hit a few redlines on the MSA/DPA/SLA. Need quick alignment on routing and whether we can accept their small SLA tweak. Can finance sign the order form or does it need exec?

maria: Thanks — can you drop the redline excerpt? I skimmed earlier, looks like two items: uptime SLA change + data residency appendix.

alex: Pasting the relevant snippet:
```
MSA: Section 4.2 uptime SLA -> customer requests 99.95% (we currently offer 99.9% for free tier, 99.99% for Dedicated).
DPA: they require EU data to be stored for retention 7y in eu-west-1 and HSM-backed keys.
Order Form: billing net60 -> they want net45.
```

maria: Ok. SLA bump to 99.95 is in between our tiers. We can offer 99.95 on Dedicated with a small uplift fee. HSM + EU residency: need to confirm Private offering or Dedicated region (legal + infra).

sam: From SE side — Orion needs Dedicated GPUs for inference latency tests. POC config: 2x A100, 8 vCPU control plane, 3-month term. They want start this week.

alex: Also pricing question — they asked if POC credits convert to committed spend if we go to Dedicated.

kyle: We can credit back POC spend towards a reserved commitment if they sign within 30 days. Standard conversion: 70% credit toward initial month reserve. Need PO from customer.

maria: For signature routing: we usually route the MSA to legal@redwood + their sig, order form to finance for PO and then exec only if > $200k ARR. This POC < $25k so finance sign ok.

alex: Perfect. Who owns sending the esign envelope? I can or someone from legal?

maria: I'll prep the redline response and send as a tracked envelope. Please attach the revised order form with PO placeholder. Use DocuSign and CC finance (kyle) + solutions (sam).

alex: Tagging @toni for a quick check — can we host the POC in eu-west-1 with HSM-backed keys?

toni: Short answer: yes, on Dedicated in eu-west-1 we can enable KMS with HSM. Need 48h to provision and verify. Will need customer KMS details if they insist on their own keys.

alex: Noted. I'll ask Orion about bringing their KMS or using our per-customer CMK.

kyle: Also confirm billing terms. If they insist net45 we can accept for the POC only, but require net30/45 recons at contract stage. I'll document exception on the order form.

maria: One more legal question — they want a carveout in DPA for research data sharing. We do not allow sharing unless anonymized + customer consent. I'll propose language: "anonymized derivatives for benchmarking only, no raw export."

alex: Great. Timeline? Maria will send envelope by EOD, Toni will provision infra within 48h after envelope, Kyle will mark finance sign for POC.

maria: Sending envelope now — DocuSign (env_8942).
deply-bot: deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope env_8942 created by maria at 2024-01-02T14:12:08Z

kyle: Got it. I'll watch for the PO and approve.

alex: I'll message Orion to accept the minor SLA uplift fee and confirm PO and KMS choice.

sam: I'll standby for infra confirmation and will run latency tests once Toni confirms.

maria: Closing loop — redline response will accept 99.95 SLA on Dedicated with +10% monthly fee, DPA residency accepted for eu-west-1, HSM enabled option documented, order form updated with PO placeholder and net45 for POC. Envelope sent.

alex: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
